item.title: Orange County Mayor debates suing federal government
item.description: Jerry Demings said the federal government is putting a burden on local governments by failing to adequately compensate them for costs associated with housing ICE detainees.

item.title: Two Bridges Pub & Eatery closes unexpectedly
item.description: The spot located at 16112 Marsh Road, Winter Garden, opened for the last time Tuesday, Feb. 3, and unexpectedly closed its doors.

item.title: Windermere Lakes Cleanup Day postponed
item.description: Lakes Cleanup Day, originally scheduled for Sunday, Feb. 8, was postponed due to inclement weather and low registration.

item.title: CFS Coffee is coming to Horizon West
item.description: The coffee shop will be opening at the new Shoppes at Lakeview Pointe.

item.title: Oakland Nature Preserve cancels Blue Hike Paddle Trip
item.description: The paddle tour Saturday, Feb. 7, is cancelled.

item.title: Harlow Grove Restaurant & Bar set to open in March in Winter Garden
item.description: The spot will be located at 186 S. Main St., Winter Garden.

item.title: Doxology to move to Plant Street
item.description: Doxology, currently located at 49 S. Main St., Winter Garden, will move to 16 E. Plant St., Winter Garden.

item.title: Play Street Museum opens in Winter Garden
item.description: The children's museum now is open from 8:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. Mondays through Fridays, located at 12107 Stoneybrook West Pkwy., Suite 104, Winter Garden.

item.title: Foundation Academy announces new president
item.description: Dr. Jeff Lawrence will be the new president. He previously served as the director of spiritual development.

item.title: FAMILIAR FACES: Jim Crescitelli is West Orange's history buff
item.description: Crescitelli, director of education with the Winter Garden Heritage Foundation, has long had a fascination with documenting history.
